name: Puerto Nare (Colombia)
description: Four horizontal stripes of white, red, light grey and green, the white charged at the hoist with a yellow star within four smaller stars.
history: Municipal flag of Puerto Nare, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: one large star surrounded by four small stars
